title: SREV-068 Winsock proxy sockaddr gate contract

connect_address.description: Caller-provided sockaddr pointer and namelen byte count

family_gate.description: AF_INET and AF_INET6 length validation before local proxy interpretation

fallback.description: Malformed or unsupported addresses fall through to the underlying Winsock API

contracts: Winsock connect-family APIs receive a sockaddr pointer plus namelen byte count
The first u_short in a valid sockaddr is the address family
AF_INET may be locally interpreted only when namelen is at least sizeof(SOCKADDR_IN)
AF_INET6 may be locally interpreted only when namelen is at least sizeof(SOCKADDR_IN6_LH)
Null, too-small, or unsupported-family addresses must not enter Sandboxie proxy routing
Malformed connect addresses must fall through to the underlying Winsock API for provider-owned errors
WSA_GetIP unsupported-family fallback comments must name the SREV-068 local interpretation gate
